       1             SENATOR DEFRANCISCO:  This is the second of

      12      in Albany, that went extremely well.

      14      next week in Buffalo, and the beginning of October

      15      in Long Island and New York City.

      17      economic climate in the state of New York, and that

      18      is good.  We've cut spending substantially, we've

      19      provided some tax relief, and we're trying to turn

      20      the corner, with the assistance of the Governor.

      22      we are in a position that we've got to do much more.

      24      Tax Foundation from Washington, confirming that

      25      we're number 50 of all the states, as far as
